message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned when you finish a round by playing all your cards and collecting the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On your turn you may:
• **Play** one card that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card, or a Wild card.
• **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot play. If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you risk being challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – Knowing what’s coming helps you plan your moves. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save them for when you’re stuck or to change the color to your advantage. 3. **Watch your opponents’ cards** – If they’re close to finishing, you might want to play a “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” to delay them. 4. **Challenge wisely** – Only challenge a “Wild Draw Four” if you’re sure the player had a playable card; otherwise you’ll get penalized. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
